title: Office of Naval Intelligence man offers Dark Skies creators a deal, which they refuse

plain: In the mid-1990s, while they were making Dark Skies, a TV series about a hidden government UFO cover-up, its creators say a man from the Office of Naval Intelligence, the US Navy's spy service, came to them in Los Angeles with a deal, and they turned it down. Brent Friedman, one of the show's creators, tells Michels he was in the room, along with his writing partner Bryce Zabel. He says the man was "so abusive to us in the conference room" and that, under the deal, this man would effectively have become their boss, which suggests the military wanted a hand in how UFOs were shown on screen.
